name: NG-5
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle needs NG-5 for his explosive plans. The volatile chemical is Nitromirglyceronium, the ignition compound he needs to set off wagons loaded with dynamite as a distraction.

sections.title: A Volatile Reagent
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome operative in the Stonetalon Mountains, needs NG-5 for his engineering plans. The compound is formally known as Nitromirglyceronium, a hazardous chemical solution that demands care—or reckless gnomish enthusiasm. Gaxim says it provides the reaction needed to detonate entire wagons loaded with dynamite, creating a massive explosion to distract his adversaries in the region.

faq.answer: NG-5 is short for Nitromirglyceronium, a highly unstable chemical used as an ignition reagent in advanced demolition and gnomish engineering.
Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer in the Stonetalon Mountains, needs NG-5 as the ignition compound for several wagons packed with dynamite, which he plans to use as a distraction.
NG-5 is extremely dangerous to handle. The supplier warns couriers to treat it with absolute care and jokes that anyone who is not Gaxim's ally will likely blow themselves to pieces.

angles.text: Engineers will recognize NG-5 as Nitromirglyceronium, a temperamental chemical catalyst prized by tinkers when ordinary black powder lacks the punch for heavy ordinance.
As a gnome, you may recognize the high-risk ingenuity in using an unstable chemical to blow up whole wagons of dynamite as a simple distraction.
